title: GOV-0008: 'Draft PR = live delivery dossier' -- nothing produces or checks one
problem:
## Observed
The doctrine table maps Draft PR → *live delivery dossier*. No dossier is produced for or checked on any PR. `WP-2026-0010`'s G07/G08 dossiers live under `work/` and were gated by hand; BADF's own WPs (`0016`, `0018`) carry **no gate dossier at all** — they merged on CI + traceability only.

## Expected
> Merge only after current composed-tree verification, independent challenge, authority validation, and evidence binding.
A PR carries (or links) the dossier for its WP's target gate and CI runs `badf_gate.py dossier` on it, so authority validation and evidence binding are exercised for BADF's own work packages, not only for foreign ones.

## Evidence
`ls work/WP-2026-0016 work/WP-2026-0018` → `work-package.json` only, on `c510516`.

## Unknowns
Whether a self-WP at `change_class: C3` can satisfy a G07 dossier at all under a single collaborator — `author ∉ approvers` cannot be met, the same deviation already recorded for reviews in `GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md`. To be recorded, not hidden. Related: #21 (composed-tree gate).

## Proposed work package
Define the minimum self-WP dossier; CI validates it on `pull_request`; the approvals deviation recorded in the dossier as a carried condition.
